liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hey Pocky Way** (2 reviews): Works well as a direct, bright, cheerful opener for the three-night stand; Reviewer says Brent and the band tear into it, launching the first set [18][22]
- **Gimme Some Lovin'** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer hears some sloppy moments in the Spencer Davis collaboration; Gimme Some Lovin' features Spencer Davis [9][19]
- **The Wheel** (1 review, 1 other source): Space fakes out into Playin', and The Wheel then really locks in; A Playin' tease comes right before The Wheel [9][15]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer finds this Althea lacking backbone and vigor [18]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer finds it dull, though the messy climax finally heats up [18]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Cassidy exceptional [22]
- **Two Soldiers Jam** (1 review): The jam labeled Two Soldiers actually uses the Handsome Cabin Boy melody, according to this reviewer [16]
- **Playin' Reprise** (1 review): Reviewer argues the short jam is Playin', since Jerry noodles just before starting the riff [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **Two Soldiers Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [27]

## The recordings

- **gd87-09-22.sbd.frisco.16139.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 145 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording crisp [15]
- **gd1987-09-22.154369.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [9]
- **gd1987-09-22.137000.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 150 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1987-09-22.137002.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 150 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended from the seventh row, center [15]
- Second set opens with a special guest joining the band [22]
- Handsome Cabin Boy and Two Soldiers share timing and notes; similar jams turn up on 12/9/91 and 12/17/90 [17]
- The same jam was also played at the 9/12/90 Spectrum show and on 3/17/93 at Cap Centre [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd87-09-22.sbd.frisco.16139.sbefail.shnf**: source: Cleanup by Chris Frisco of previous seed [1]. Also: Cleanup by Chris Frisco of an earlier seed; chain is soundboard to cassette to DAT to CDR [1]
- **gd1987-09-22.154369.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [9]
- **gd1987-09-22.137000.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=134676) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (TDK MA-R90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) ->… [2]
- **gd1987-09-22.137002.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16/48kHz ; 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) - SBD (shnid=134676) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (TDK MA-R90); Transfer Info: Cassette… [3]
